title: France: Lawmakers hold a minute of silence for Pengo Bossio Wangi, victim of racist attack
summary: French lawmakers held a minute of silence for Pengo Bossio Wangi. The victim of a racist attack died in a shooting last week, while at least five other people were wounded, including a 12-years-old girl. FRANCE 24’s Claire Paccalin reports from the ground.
